name: Misasagi
message: 「I wonder what it could be? Is it wagashi?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「You see, ever since I was little, I've received heaps of presents every single birthday, so I've gotten used to it--in a bad way, I'm afraid」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Even so, this is the first time receiving something has ever made me this happy」
